Hero.name: Eduard Akhramovych
Hero.subtitle: Entrepreneur with 30+ years of experience, founder and former CEO of Art Nation.
Hero.description: I build blockbuster products and loyalty programs for global audiences. I combine business strategy with creative vision to help brands reshape their markets.

paragraphs.first: Throughout my career, I have aimed to unite creative ambition with disciplined business execution. Building companies is not only about spreadsheets, but about understanding the human needs that move markets.
paragraphs.second: From launching local startups to leading international loyalty businesses serving millions of consumers, my approach has stayed the same: bold vision, backed by systematic execution.
paragraphs.third: Today I am focused on growing Art Nation and helping businesses overcome difficult growth challenges with practical, high-impact solutions.

national-multimedia-company.title: National multimedia company
national-multimedia-company.description: Built a distribution network of 4,573 retail points for licensed compact discs. By 2007, the annual turnover reached 20 million USD with a catalog of more than 30,000 products.

art-nation.title: Art Nation
art-nation.description: Sold more than 255 million collectible products. The company works with leading retailers in Ukraine and the CIS, while clients generate more than 200 billion UAH in annual turnover.

book-of-records-ukraine.title: Book of Records of Ukraine
book-of-records-ukraine.description: Set a national record in children's book sales with 1,241,000 copies sold in 2018.

book-of-records-moldova.title: Book of Records of Moldova
book-of-records-moldova.description: Expanded a proven publishing and licensing model to a neighboring market, adapting the product strategy for local demand and growth.

lecture.title: Lecture
lecture.description: Learn the principles behind blockbuster products, systematic sales structures, channel thinking, gamification, cross-promotions, collaborations and marketing strategies that truly engage people.

speech.title: Public talk
speech.description: Looking for an experienced expert for your business event? Eduard shares practical insights on marketing, sales, gamification, loyalty and brand licensing.

consulting.title: Consultation
consulting.description: Need clarity on scaling, business models or monetizing a creative project? Eduard can review your case and suggest practical next steps.
